**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
items.information:
### This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

### Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

### Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Fasching 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Fasching 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

**OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag.

--

A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

**N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).**
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.
* **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.**

---

Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).**
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.
* **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

Why SILENCE?

We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :)

We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure.

We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. 
 
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

Happy cubing!

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association.

items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss!
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid.
Det koster 150 NOK å delta. 
Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. 
Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet.

Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo.

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015!
You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time.

We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.

items.name: Arnold Classic Africa 2022
items.information:
### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly.

### Competitor Tickets

Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at:
https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/
Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival.


### Guests

Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day.
**[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)**

### Volunteering

We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

items.name: Ohio State Expo Open 2022

venue.name: Friday: [Ohio Union Senate Chamber](https://ohiounion.osu.edu), Saturday/Sunday:  [Rhodes Center](https://ohioexpocenter.com/rental-facilities/rhodes-center)
venue.address: 1739 N. High Street, Columbus, Ohio 43210, 717 E 17th Ave, Columbus, OH 43211
venue.details: Senate Chamber is located on the second floor of the Ohio Union, Rhodes Center is located at the Ohio Expo Center

items.information:
Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. 

Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab.

**Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves
**Day 2:**  5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks
**Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb

Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis.

Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. 

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:

1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

OR

2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

**Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: **
* **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw**
* **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending**
* **Competition as a whole is cancelled**
* **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate**
**We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

items.information:
**[FR]**  

**Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.**

Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**.

Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA.

Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir.

Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs.

**[EN]**

**As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. items.information:
New Zealand Nationals 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.

Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Registration is open to all, of all nationalities.

Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.name: Tirol Open 2019
items.information:
2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol!
Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte.

Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab!

______
2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol!
Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well.

The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

items.information:
Chignahuapan, *pueblo mágico*, es el principal productor de esferas en todo el país, bello por folklor y sus paisajes naturales como la laguna de Chignahuapan, las cascadas de Quetzalapan, las aguas termales y sus bosques. Han pasado casi 8 años desde el primer Reto Chignahuapan, es hora de traer uno nuevo y no hay otra mejor manera que con un gran torneo.

Este torneo es posible gracias al staff del ***Puebla Rubik’s Team*** y al ***Gobierno municipal de Chignahuapan.***
![](https://i.imgur.com/17KskVW.jpg)

Chignahuapan, *pueblo magico*, is the main manufacturer of Christmas spheres in Mexico. Chignahuapan is beautiful because its folklore and its natural landscapes are amazing. 8 years have passed since the first *Reto Chignahuapan*, it's time to bring a new one but in shape of 2019

This tournament is supported to ***Puebla Rubik's Team*** staff and ***Chignahuapan municipal government***

items.information:
(HR)

Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. 

--------------

(EN)

Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.  Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.information:
Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя.
На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем).
Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15.
За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали!

Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain.
Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided)
The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15.
For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

**ВНИМАНИЕ:** Так как это Чемпионат Беларуси, то претендовать на призы могут только граждане Беларуси. В то же время чемпионат остаётся открытым для участия для всех национальностей.

items.name: GLS Cup II 2019
items.information:
GLS Cup 2019 is a cycle of 6 official WCA competition in Gdańsk (Northern Poland). 
From many years we cooperate with hotel Novotel Marina. Thanks to this we can provide the highest standard of cubing 
environment. Elegant ferniture, profesional audiosystem and perfect lighting. For ourdisposal we have beautiful garden with beach access. Moreover we have dedicated restaurant and foyer as a rest area. 

GLS League is connection of 6 competition. We have big rankings system. 
- General classification of all events
- 3x3x3 classification for kids, 
- 3x3x3 for parents

At the main venue we have big rollup with the names of GLS record holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. After the first day we organise cubers integration. 
Next to the hotel we have parking area and shop. 
If you want to join us, you are most welcome!

items.name: Tullinge Basement Blind 2019

venue.name: Fritidslokalen
venue.details: Enter at Månstorpsvägen 4, then go down into the basement where you´ll find the venue: Fritidslokalen

items.information:
Welcome to this blind events only competition in Tullinge, just outside Stockholm! We will only have blindsolving events at this competition. However, registration is free and the time-limits are lenient, so we would like to see many of you gathered for this competition in April! 

Please read through all the tabs on this page to get all the information you need for this competition. The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Blindfolded**. If you have any further questions, feel free to contact the organizers using the contact information on this page. 

We are not allowed to wear outside shoes inside the venue, and the floor tend to get a bit cold as it is in a basement. Therefore, a good tip is to bring some slippers or inside shoes to keep your feet warm during the day.

-----

Varmt välkomna till denna tävling med bara blindgrenar i Tullinge, strax utanför Stockholm! Vi kommer bara ha blindgrenar på denna tävling. Det är dock gratis att delta och alla time-limits är generöst satta, så vi hoppas se många av er på denna tävling i april!

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all information om denna tävling. Tävlingens huvudgren är **3x3x3 med Ögonbindel** Om du har ytterligare frågor så går det bra att kontakta arrangörerna genom kontaktinformationen på denna sida.

Det är inte tillåtet att ha på sig utomhusskor inne i tävlingslokalen och golvet tenderar och bli ganska kallt då lokalen ligger i en källare. Därför är ett bra tips att ta med er ett par innetofflor eller inomhusskor för att hålla era fötter varma under tävlingen.

items.information: NxNZ 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible (except 3x3x3 Fewest Moves). The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: No Place For DNF Spring 2019
items.information:
The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves.

-We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event.

-Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

-Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room.  You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. 

-Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com.

-All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly.

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.**

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

**This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**

items.information:
**English:**
Welcome to Mental Breakdown Norway 2019
This competition focuses on the five most advanced events we have: FM, 3 blind, 4 blind, 5 blind and multi blind. This is the first time such a competition is held in Norway. It is open to anyone who wants to attend, but since the events are quite demanding, we do not expect many first timers. Note that we do not compete in normal 3x3 at this competition! Also note that we only allow 30 competitors.

**Norwegian:**
Velkommen til Mental Breakdown Norge 2019!
Dette er en WCA-konkurranse som fokuserer på de fem mest krevende eventene vi har: FM, 3-blind,4-blind, 5-blind og multiblind. Dette er den første av sitt slag i Norge. Alle som ønsker å delta er velkommen, men siden eventene er ganske krevende, så vi regner med at de fleste som kommer har deltatt på konkurranse før. Legg merke til at vi ikke konkurrerer i vanlig 3x3 i denne konkurransen! Legg også merke til at vi kun godtar opp til 30 deltakere.

1. Если участник приходит без совершеннолетнего сопровождающего, то он обязан при себе иметь письменное заявление-согласие от родителей либо опекунов, о том, что они самостоятельно несут ответственность за несовершеннолетнего ребенка.
2. Головоломки используемые в соревнованиях должны иметь отличительные отметки, по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец (например: нацарапанные инициалы или имя с внутренней стороны съемной крышки) 


======================================================
После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни).
В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность.

For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019).

Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please
carefully check the entered data.

If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration.

**ATTENTION!!!
1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child.
2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover)
**

After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted.
If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with
a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation.
Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be
accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend).
On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.

items.information:
Den eneste disciplin der vil blive afholdt til denne konkurrence er 3x3x3 i Færrest Træk! Der vil være pauser mellem de tre forsøg, hvor vi kan have noget julesjov. Vi vil lave pakkeleg, hvor det er muligt at deltage, hvis man medbringer en lille gave. Efter konkurrencen vil det være muligt at blive og hygge til klokken 20:00.

Frokost og julesnacks vil blive serveret i løbet af dagen og er en del af detagergebyret. Det vil også være muligt at få aftensmad, men det vil koste ekstra :)
____
The only event which will be held at this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves! There will be breaks between the attempts where we can have some Christmas fun. One of these activities will be "Pakkeleg" where you can bring a small gift if you wish to participate. After the competition it will be possible to stay for hygge until 20:00. 

Lunch and Christmas snacks will be provided in the registration fee. Dinner is optional and will cost extra :)

venue.name: Quinnipiac University Athletic and Recreation Center
venue.address: 275 Mt Carmel Ave, Hamden, CT 06518, USA
venue.details: The competition will take place in the main gymnasium. There is a parking lot in front which has free parking.

items.information:
Quinnipiac University will host its first official WCA competition this September! We are planning a competition with a relaxed but engaging and social atmosphere, that will hopefully give the Connecticut cubing community a chance to connect.

The theme of this competition is breadth rather than depth. Our events will sample a variety of puzzle categories, from larger cubes (4x4) and different solving approaches (One-Handed, Blindfolded, Fewest Moves), to puzzles of different shapes (Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1). All events except the traditional 3x3 speedsolve will be single rounds; Fewest Moves in particular will consist of **one** hour-long attempt.

Family, friends, and guests are welcome, but we ask competitors to let us know the number of people attending on their registration forms. The parking lot in front of the venue should be free of charge, but there are no guarantees if that particular lot reaches capacity.

We look forward to seeing you in September!

items.information:
Registration Fee:
There is a **$20** registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. Please keep an eye out for the e-mail saying you have been approved. Registration is on a first-come first-serve and the same will go for the waitlist once registration fills up. Please do not register unless you intend on competing as it will open up a spot for another competitor who does intend on competing.

**We will only be accepting online payment at this competition. If you have any issues with this, please contact us!**

There is a **25 competitor limit** to the competition. Please register as soon as possible if you plan on coming! Registration closes at the end of the day on July 7th. We will grant refunds to those who let us know by July 7th, but no refunds are granted after that date.

items.name: Semey Open 2018
items.information:
Dear competitors and guests!

1. The official opening ceremony will be held on June 7, 2018 at 7 pm. According to our idea, it will be held at the main square of the city. For the ceremony we will prepare a special show with the famous speedcubers. In this regard, we recommend arriving in the city no later than 12.00 hours on June 7.

2. The base fee allows to compete in 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, Skewb, Pyraminx and Clock. For any other event you will need to pay additionally 1000 KZT per event.

3. The winner of each event will receive a prize!

===========

Барлық қатысушылар мен қонақтардың назарына !!!
1. Ресми ашылу 2018 жылдың 7 маусымында сағат 19.00-де өтеді, қаланың орталық алаңында өтеді. Салтанатты ашылу рәсімі үшін атақты спидкуберлер қатысуымен шоу-бағдарлама дайындалады. Осыған байланысты біз 7-маусымда сағат 12.00-ден кешіктірмей қалаға келуді ұсынамыз.

2. Негізгі сыйақы 2x2x2 куб, 3x3x3 куб, Skewb, Pyraminx және Clock бойынша бәсекелесуге мүмкіндік береді. Кез-келген басқа іс-шараға қосымша бір оқиға үшін 1000 теңге төлеуге тура келеді.

3. Әр жарыстың жеңімпазы жүлде алады.

===========

Дополнительная информация:

Внимание всем участникам и гостям!!!

1. Официальная церемония открытия, состоится 7 июня 2018 года в 19.00 ч. По нашей задумке она будет проходить на главной площади города. Для церемонии будет подготовлена специальная шоу программа с участием именитых спидкуберов. В связи с этим рекомендуем прибыть в город не позднее 12.00 часов 7 июня.

2. Регистрационный взнос позволяет принять участие в дисциплинах: 2х2, Rubik's Cube, Skweb, Piraminx, Clock. Для участия в других дисциплинах необходимо оплатить  дополнительный взнос по 1000 тенге за каждую дисциплину.  

3. За первое место во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы

items.name: Heimaey Open 2018
items.information:
This competition will take place on the 6th of June and it is the first competition ever in Heimaey!
To get to the island you need to go with a ferry called Herjólfur. The harbor is called Landeyjahöfn and is ~2 hours away from Reykjavík. It is possible to take a bus from there. You can order tickets to the ferry here - https://www.seatours.is/ .
You can check out booking.com or airbnb.com for information about hotels and other places to stay in over night.
Our goal with the schedule is to have events that were not held at Icelandic nationals.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Þetta mót verður haldið 6. júni og er það fyrsta mótið á Heimaey frá upphafi!
Til þess að komast á eyjuna þarft þú að fara með ferjunni Herjólfi. Hann er staðsettur í Landeyjahöfn og er u.þ.b. tveggja klukkustunda keyrsla frá Reykjavík til Landeyjahafnar. Hægt er að taka strætó á milli staða. 
Hér getur þú pantað miða í Herjólf - https://www.saeferdir.is/ferdir-i-bodi/vestmannaeyjar/
Þú getur kíkt á booking.com / airbnb.com fyrir upplýsingar um hótel eða aðra gistingu í Vestmannaeyjum.

items.information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation, ID and a KungFu QingHong 3x3x3) starts at Php 300.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event, this is up to March 31, 2018 only for the early bird. Regular base registration fee of Php 350 for 3 events will apply starting in April. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on May 13, 2018 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Requests for change of events are only allowed up to the registration cut-off. Strictly no refund and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
